timebase: sourceFrame at 30000/1001 fps; clip starts at original frame 2422
coordinate_system: glTF model: Y up, X and Z horizontal; pelvis centered; metres derive from inferred MHR scale and are not field calibrated
left_knee_2d: acos normalized dot product hip-knee and ankle-knee, image projection
left_knee_rig3d: same internal angle from the actual corrected GLB bones MHR_002,003,004
ankle_elevation: atan2(deltaY, hypot(deltaX,deltaZ)); displacement over exactly 3 replay frames =0.1001 s; absent where the full future window is unavailable
interpolation: 202 observed poses and 9 short-gap interpolated frames in source 2500–2710; other source frames have no rig measurements
ball_centroids: SAM 3.1 visible segmented pixels, not inferred physical sphere centres
limits: Replay already slow motion; no physical velocities.
Monocular depth and scale are estimates.
Session-only 2D edits are not included in this baseline export.
